svg.title: Order reverses implication
svg.desc: Equality patterns accepted by the OR and AND families of two sources, and the two-source lattice in which a higher node has a smaller event.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: 1 = equal to the anchor's value, 0 = different
every pattern the AND family accepts,
the OR family accepts as well
